# Proposal

<!-- pdac-scope: cited -->

## Why

[Issue #437](https://github.com/juangcarmona/lighthouse/issues/437) identifies skipped and neutral GitHub check runs being projected as passed and therefore accepted as successful verification citations. Correct the observed-evidence projection without changing which checks GitHub requires or accepts for merge.

## What Changes

- In `observeChecks`, reserve passed check-run evidence for a matching-revision, completed `success`; project completed `skipped` and `neutral` as unavailable while preserving the exact native conclusion in `state`.
- Exercise `observeChecks` followed by `assertCitedChecks` using independent native-ID and URL-only citation selectors; retain successful, pending, failed, wrong-revision, missing and refreshed-evidence behavior.
- Add controls preserving `checkCommit` hosting semantics and optional-job non-gating behavior, plus the named SDLC patch changeset.
- Leave required-check policy, signatures, callers, workflows, permissions, retry behavior and CI triggers unchanged.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities

None.

### Modified Capabilities

None. This repairs implementation of existing truthful-evidence requirements, not their meaning or a spec-level contract. The inspected `openspec/specs/` inventory contains only `.gitkeep`; no capability is introduced or replaced. Return `.openspec.yaml` containing only `skip_specs: true`; the host combines it with provider-owned metadata.

## Impact

Implementation is bounded to `src/packages/sdlc/src/completion.mjs`, `src/tests/completion.test.mjs` and `.changeset/skipped-check-evidence.md`, plus this host-owned plan. Consumers see corrected observation statuses through existing APIs; no schema, dependency, persisted-data migration, package-version edit or remote setting changes are needed. The production edit stays within the observation projection; `assertCitedChecks`, `checkCommit` and `requiredPolicy` remain unchanged.

### Product context

Before drafting, discovery compared the issue with the host-prepared whole-model index of 137 artifacts and widened the evidence roots through their direct/transitive impact reports. Relevant canonical texts and provider-emitted citation payloads supply these dependencies to preserve, not artifacts to edit:

- `BR-FAIL-CLOSED`: unavailable verification is explicit, never presented as compliance.
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-FAIL-CLOSED" digest="sha256:1a8bdc2e330fb683bd1354d898b1072d4a5fe30aeab26d3c02b2036352a7fc8d" -->
- `FR-CHANGE-EVIDENCE`: reports distinguish inspected evidence and unresolved findings from successful implementation.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-CHANGE-EVIDENCE" digest="sha256:9207c491167fcdb5cebf14dc750bb0ac5441f847c4607cd94111385128b692f0" -->
- `BR-HUMAN-AUTHORITY`: product, architecture acceptance, merge and release retain their human or explicitly delegated owners.
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-HUMAN-AUTHORITY" digest="sha256:c26daacd93dfc059f9ff99cdac179a2ee0d136d5c02cd146b92b3c46e49752e8" -->
- `UC-IMPLEMENT-CHANGE`: implementation consumes the reviewed plan and produces actual Done evidence; integration remains separate.
<!-- pdac:cite id="UC-IMPLEMENT-CHANGE" digest="sha256:fc65ab1eb13b9a5e66e3a7d7efd57bb1c3bd3e6ea92c092d4e40ee5856a40ee6" -->
- `FR-FAST-FORWARD-DELIVERY`: keep separate independent plan/candidate review, current evidence and separately authorized integration; planning grants no delivery authority.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-FAST-FORWARD-DELIVERY" digest="sha256:cc98eedbd3f9938c82ea59e4f7499d90a1cf4cf52da707d740d9f24d800bec2e" -->

Checked impact neighbours not targeted include `FR-FOUNDATION-UPGRADE`, `FR-MODEL-PROFILES`, `FR-REPOSITORY-CONVENTIONS`, `FR-SEMANTIC-INITIALIZATION`, `FR-VERIFY-FOUNDATION`, `SB-VERIFY`, `UC-VERIFY-FOUNDATION`, `UC-UPDATE-FOUNDATION`, `BR-ENTRY-AUTHORITY`, `BR-STAGE-GATES`, `BR-PRODUCT-CHANGE-HANDOFF`, `BR-MEMORY-BOUNDARY` and `UC-BUILD-PUBLIC-STORY`: no upgrade, initialization, catalogue, lifecycle, memory or site behavior changes. `TERM-GUARDRAIL`, `TERM-INTEGRATION`, `TERM-MANAGED-PROJECTION` and `BC-FOUNDATION` retain their existing meanings. Graph adjacency alone does not expand this correction.

Product definition drift: none identified; no altered product intent or Product Change is proposed. Relevant supplied artifacts are draft, and read-only discovery is not product approval. Architecture evidence-state and execution-authority boundaries in `docs/architecture/08-crosscutting-concepts/README.md` remain unchanged.

## Verification and next decision

[Design](design.md) defines precedence and behavioral controls; [tasks](tasks.md) retains all admitted commands and the Definition of Done. These are planned checks, not receipts. The trusted host validates and materializes this plan before separate independent plan review. This proposal neither dispatches the pilot nor certifies #394/#392 completion, changes supervised comparison #391, or authorizes implementation, merge, release or deployment.

# Design

<!-- pdac-scope: cited -->

## Context

See [proposal.md](proposal.md) for motivation and product discovery. `completion.mjs:93-120` projects check runs and commit statuses separately, then guards passed citations against both original and refreshed observations. The check-run projection currently shares the `success`/`neutral`/`skipped` acceptance set used by `checkCommit`, conflating verification with hosting eligibility. `inspectCompletion` and `completion-actions.mjs` already separate policy checks from cited observations; no caller change is necessary.

## Goals / Non-Goals

**Goals:** Narrow verification acceptance at its projection source while retaining native identity, conclusion and freshness checks. Unexecuted or non-successful evidence must not establish successful verification.
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-FAIL-CLOSED" digest="sha256:1a8bdc2e330fb683bd1354d898b1072d4a5fe30aeab26d3c02b2036352a7fc8d" -->

**Non-Goals:** New gates, classifier infrastructure, signature/schema changes, historical evidence rewrites, citation-guard redesign, hosting-policy edits, triggers, retries, bypasses, new dependencies or product/architecture edits.

## Decisions

### 1. Correct only check-run observation status

Keep the existing precedence: revision mismatch first, incomplete execution second, then classify the completed conclusion. Change only the local expression in `observeChecks`; preserve `evidenceId`, name, requested revision, app, URL and native `state` construction.

| Input | Observed status | Observed state |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wrong revision, including completed success/skipped/neutral | failed | Existing native conclusion or pending |
| Matching revision, queued/in progress | unavailable | pending |
| Matching revision, completed success | passed | success |
| Matching revision, completed skipped | unavailable | skipped |
| Matching revision, completed neutral | unavailable | neutral |
| Matching revision, any other completed conclusion | failed | Unchanged native conclusion |

Commit-status projection and latest-status selection remain unchanged, as does current-workflow job exclusion. Do not reuse this narrower rule in `checkCommit` or `requiredPolicy`: hosting eligibility intentionally continues to accept eligible completed success/skipped/neutral required checks. Optional unrequired jobs remain observations, not additional gates. A shared helper would blur this deliberate distinction and is unnecessary.

### 2. Reuse the citation guard

Leave `assertCitedChecks` unchanged. It already requires a selected observation to be passed both before and after refresh, with the same evidence identity and revision. Fixing its input projection rejects skipped/neutral evidence through either matching native ID or matching exact URL. Adding conclusion checks to the guard instead would leave incorrect passed observations exposed to other consumers.

Reports retain raw evidence context and explicit unavailability rather than suppressing skipped/neutral observations or manufacturing a successful receipt.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-CHANGE-EVIDENCE" digest="sha256:9207c491167fcdb5cebf14dc750bb0ac5441f847c4607cd94111385128b692f0" -->

### 3. Test the existing public functions

Extend only `src/tests/completion.test.mjs`, using deterministic fake GitHub API responses with native IDs, URLs, app identity and head SHA. Obtain snapshots through `observeChecks`, not manually edited projected statuses. For each selector, use ID alone without source, then an unrelated local evidence ID with only the exact native URL as source, so one path cannot mask the other.

- Matching completed success is passed and citable through each selector; skipped and neutral are unavailable with exact state and reject passed citations.
- For both selectors, refresh an initially successful observation as skipped, neutral, queued/in-progress, failed, wrong-revision or absent; every earlier passed citation is rejected. Check initially unavailable/failed observations also cannot support passed citations.
- Cover wrong-revision success/skipped/neutral precedence, ordinary failed conclusions, absent native IDs remaining unauthenticated, and existing behavior for non-passed evidence claims. A URL matched before but missing after is rejected; do not invent new behavior for arbitrary unmatched URLs.
- Retain controls for commit statuses, latest selection and current-workflow exclusion.
- Through `checkCommit`, show eligible completed success/skipped/neutral required runs still pass. Use realistic authenticated GitHub Actions origin responses for the required-check control; retain existing wrong-app, wrong-revision, pending, missing and ineligible-event regressions. Add optional skipped/neutral runs alongside a successful required run and assert no extra required result or gate. Retain configured-policy matching controls without editing policy code.

Add `.changeset/skipped-check-evidence.md` with `"@juangcarmona/lighthouse-sdlc": patch`, describing only corrected verification reporting and preserved merge eligibility. No version, lockfile or workflow pin edit.

### 4. Preserve authority and evidence provenance

ProductShape owns intent, ArcShape owns architecture and the host owns effects. This proposal supplies no acceptance, merge or release decision.
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-HUMAN-AUTHORITY" digest="sha256:c26daacd93dfc059f9ff99cdac179a2ee0d136d5c02cd146b92b3c46e49752e8" -->

Separate read-only independent plan and candidate reviews require fresh context and a different configured model under existing policy. Local commands, agent observations, current-head required forge checks and accepted post-merge review are distinct evidence; none substitutes for another or delegates integration.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-FAST-FORWARD-DELIVERY" digest="sha256:cc98eedbd3f9938c82ea59e4f7499d90a1cf4cf52da707d740d9f24d800bec2e" -->

## Risks / Trade-offs

- [Accidental merge-policy tightening] → Keep hosting functions untouched; test the contrast between unavailable observations and eligible required-check acceptance.
- [Pending or revision precedence regresses] → Assert the full projection table and original/refreshed citation paths through production functions.
- [A test exercises ID and URL together] → Use independent single-selector claims for both rejection and genuine success.
- [Corrected reporting exposes less successful evidence] → Retain native conclusions; an unavailable optional job is not a new required gate or permission to retry.

## Migration Plan

Land one bounded code/test/changeset slice after accepted independent planning review, then run [tasks.md](tasks.md)'s candidate checks and independent candidate review. No data migration or external configuration change is needed. Integration and post-merge review follow separate existing authorization. If reversal is later authorized, revert only the isolated implementation commit; reverting restores the reporting defect and is not proof of successful verification.

# Tasks

<!-- pdac-scope: cited -->

All items remain unchecked. The admitted `context.unattended.implementationChecks` inventory is a plan, not an execution receipt. No implementation command ran during proposal preparation.

## 1. Bounded evidence correction

The slice preserves explicit unavailable evidence and reviewable outcomes rather than representing absence of successful execution as compliance.
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-FAIL-CLOSED" digest="sha256:1a8bdc2e330fb683bd1354d898b1072d4a5fe30aeab26d3c02b2036352a7fc8d" -->
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-CHANGE-EVIDENCE" digest="sha256:9207c491167fcdb5cebf14dc750bb0ac5441f847c4607cd94111385128b692f0" -->

- [ ] 1.1 Install locked dependencies with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; verify successful exit and retain the actual command, candidate revision and outcome without treating installation as behavioral verification.
- [ ] 1.2 In `src/tests/completion.test.mjs`, add the design's observation/citation matrix using `observeChecks` and `assertCitedChecks`, independent ID-only and URL-only selectors, initial skipped/neutral rejection, genuine success, refresh rejection, pending, failed, wrong-revision and missing controls; verify the new skipped/neutral controls expose the current defect with `node --test src/tests/completion.test.mjs`.
- [ ] 1.3 Change only `observeChecks`' local check-run status expression in `src/packages/sdlc/src/completion.mjs` to distinguish completed success from skipped/neutral without altering state or precedence; verify the matrix passes with `node --test src/tests/completion.test.mjs`.
- [ ] 1.4 In the same test file, add/retain eligible required success/skipped/neutral and optional-job controls through `checkCommit`, configured-policy matching, commit-status/latest selection and current-workflow exclusion regressions; verify `node --test src/tests/completion.test.mjs` passes and diff inspection confirms no `checkCommit`, `requiredPolicy`, citation-guard or caller edits.
- [ ] 1.5 Add `.changeset/skipped-check-evidence.md` for an `@juangcarmona/lighthouse-sdlc` patch describing the reporting correction and unchanged merge eligibility; verify its frontmatter against existing changesets and that the implementation diff contains only the three admitted files plus this host-owned plan.

## 2. Candidate integration checks

Implementation must produce actual evidence for the Done gate; a planned command, installed package or provider status is not execution evidence.
<!-- pdac:cite id="UC-IMPLEMENT-CHANGE" digest="sha256:fc65ab1eb13b9a5e66e3a7d7efd57bb1c3bd3e6ea92c092d4e40ee5856a40ee6" -->

- [ ] 2.1 Run `env GITHUB_ACTIONS=true PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm run verify` on the completed candidate; retain the real exit/result and diagnostics, and stop dependent advancement on failure or unavailable required verification.
- [ ] 2.2 Verify/refresh affected proposal citations against current provider-emitted payloads without editing canonical product text or deleting bindings; run `npx --no-install prodshape citations verify --provider openspec --format json` and verify current citations and exactly one valid scope declaration in every changed Markdown document, retaining the provider report.
- [ ] 2.3 Run `npx --yes --package=@fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0 openspec validate issue-437-proposal --strict --no-interactive` against the host-materialized plan; verify successful strict validation, required documents and final provider metadata with `skip_specs: true`, retaining the actual outcome.

## Definition of Done

The bounded correction and changeset are delivered with the design's production-function controls passing, all five admitted commands have actual successful receipts for the candidate, citations/provider validation are current, and scope/policy preservation is demonstrated. Additional agent-run observations must name their own command, revision, outcome and provenance; they cannot replace trusted host checks. Candidate readiness is not authorization to merge or a claim of accepted post-merge delivery.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-CHANGE-EVIDENCE" digest="sha256:9207c491167fcdb5cebf14dc750bb0ac5441f847c4607cd94111385128b692f0" -->

## Workflow follow-up

- The trusted host validates/materializes this envelope, then obtains accepted separate independent plan review before implementation. After candidate checks, obtain independent candidate review with fresh context and a different configured model; findings or uncertain evidence stop continuation.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-FAST-FORWARD-DELIVERY" digest="sha256:cc98eedbd3f9938c82ea59e4f7499d90a1cf4cf52da707d740d9f24d800bec2e" -->
- The authorized host rechecks the current bounded grant, intent, scope, source and hosting policy, observes current-revision required forge CI separately from local checks, and performs integration only under separate authorization. Await actual adopted post-merge checks and accepted post-merge review before claiming delivery complete; archive only after applicable review and citation requirements are satisfied. No new workflow, dispatch, retry or bypass is requested.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-FAST-FORWARD-DELIVERY" digest="sha256:cc98eedbd3f9938c82ea59e4f7499d90a1cf4cf52da707d740d9f24d800bec2e" -->
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-HUMAN-AUTHORITY" digest="sha256:c26daacd93dfc059f9ff99cdac179a2ee0d136d5c02cd146b92b3c46e49752e8" -->
